title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 22
statement: The letters \(A,\) \(J,\) \(H,\) \(S,\) \(M,\) \(E\) and the digits \(1,\) \(9,\) \(8,\) \(9\) are each cycled separately (shifted one place at a time) to build a numbered list. Starting from AJHSME \(1989,\) the list begins: line \(1\) is JHSMEA \(9891,\) line \(2\) is HSMEAJ \(8919,\) line \(3\) is SMEAJH \(9198,\) and so on. On what numbered line will AJHSME \(1989\) appear for the first time?

solutions.text:
The six letters cycle back to their original order AJHSME every \(6\) lines, and the four digits cycle back to \(1989\) every \(4\) lines.

Both happen on the same line at the least common multiple of \(6\) and \(4,\) which is \(12.\) So AJHSME \(1989\) first reappears on line \(12.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
